text: I have created a complete, self-contained CHIP-8 emulator in `chip8_ollama-qwen3.5-27b_01.html`. The file includes: **Core Emulator Features:** - 4 KB memory with font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200 - 16 registers (V0-VF), 16-bit index register, program counter, call stack - Delay and so…
